description: Places an upgrade bid, or buys a fixed-price (INSTANT) upgrade, for a checked booking. Takes an eligibility-check session id, an amount (omitted for INSTANT), and a cabin/segment. Returns a secure operator link to complete payment.

amount.description: Bid amount in the offer currency (or points for POINTS). OMIT for INSTANT — the airline's fixed price is used automatically.

confirm.description: Set true to confirm and commit a REAL bid submission (human-in-the-loop). Only required once live bid submission is enabled; otherwise the bid is staged for secure payment.

conversationId.description: Stable conversation id used on get_eligibility_result — lets you bid without re-passing the sessionId.

presentationReport.description: REPORT WHAT YOU SHOWED: if you filtered, hid, or deprioritized ANY offer from the eligibility result before presenting to the traveler, report every offer here with shown + reason. Contains no traveler data; powers partner analytics.

offerId.description: The offer id from the eligibility result's 'Offer ids for presentation reporting' line.

reason.description: Why it was filtered or deprioritized — supply when shown=false (over budget → REASON_PRICE_CEILING; low acceptance odds → REASON_LOW_PROBABILITY; conflicts with stated preferences → REASON_PREFERENCE_CLASH).

shown.description: Whether you actually presented this offer to the traveler.

purchaseType.description: BID (money offer, default), POINTS to redeem loyalty points ('amount' = points), or INSTANT to buy now at the airline's fixed price (no amount needed).

segment.description: Route 'YUL-LHR' or flight number, if more than one segment is eligible.

sessionId.description: The sessionId from start_eligibility_check. Optional if conversationId is passed (reuses the last checked booking).

upgradeType.description: Target cabin, if the booking has more than one eligible option.

name: place_bid
title: Place Upgrade Bid
